sources.snippet: DeepNet-for-Semantic-Labeling-Photogrammetry This project aim to automated extraction of urban objects from data acquired by airborne sensors which very high-resolution data (leads to high intra-class variance while the inter-class variance is low), focus is on detailed 2D semantic segmentation that assigns labels to multiple object categories.
